codes.title: Tuberculosis of lung
evidence_quotes: sputum sent for genexpert - result awaited
codes.reasoning: The patient presents with classic features of pulmonary tuberculosis including a chronic 3-week cough unresponsive to amoxicillin, hemoptysis, night sweats, unintentional weight loss, and household TB exposure, aligned with GDL-019. As sputum GeneXpert testing is pending and anti-TB treatment is withheld until test confirmation, the condition is coded as suspected/pending.
